zh.title: 加拿大Coulson採購10架C-130運輸機改裝消防機
zh.summary: Coulson Aviation Canada宣布於2026年8月7日向加拿大政府購入10架前皇家加拿大空軍CC-130H運輸機，使其全球C-130H機隊數量翻倍。該公司將在英屬哥倫比亞省主導改裝，使用其RADS-XXL系統將這些飛機改裝為可載運4000加侖滅火劑的大型空中消防機。
body: Coulson Aviation Canada於2026年8月7日宣布，已直接向加拿大政府購買10架前皇家加拿大空軍的CC-130H大力神運輸機。此項採購使該公司全球的C-130H機隊數量從10架倍增至20架。
該公司計劃使用其RADS-XXL滅火劑釋放系統，將新購得的運輸機改裝為大型空中消防灑水機。該系統能載運高達4000加侖（超過15000公升）的水或消防阻燃劑。
Coulson Aviation Canada將在英屬哥倫比亞省親自帶領此改裝計畫，包含相關的工程、認證、修改、維護、培訓以及後續的飛行營運工作。

en.title: Coulson Aviation Canada Acquires 10 C-130 Hercules Aircraft for Firefighting
en.summary: Coulson Aviation Canada has acquired 10 former Royal Canadian Air Force CC-130H Hercules aircraft directly from the Canadian government. This acquisition doubles the company's global C-130H fleet from 10 to 20 aircraft. Announced on August 7, 2026, Coulson plans to convert these newly acquired military aircraft into large airtankers equipped with its RADS-XXL retardant delivery system, which can carry up to 4,000 gallons of fire retardant. Coulson Aviation Canada will manage the entire conversion, engineering, and certification program in British Columbia.
body: Coulson Aviation Canada announced on August 7, 2026, that it has acquired 10 retired CC-130H Hercules aircraft directly from the Canadian government. The aircraft formerly served the Royal Canadian Air Force (RCAF). This transaction doubles Coulson's global fleet of C-130H aircraft from 10 to 20.

The company plans to convert these newly acquired military aircraft into large airtankers. Each aircraft will be equipped with Coulson's RADS-XXL retardant delivery system, which can carry up to 4,000 gallons, or over 15,000 liters, of water or fire retardant to support firefighting operations.

Coulson Aviation Canada will lead the entire conversion program locally in British Columbia. The company's responsibilities for the fleet will encompass engineering, certification, modification, maintenance, training, and flight operations.
